environment.description: Same Lambda function deployed as a container image running on EKS Fargate with AWS App Mesh sidecar (Envoy proxy). Pod is subject to a Kubernetes NetworkPolicy of type 'Egress' applied via Calico CNI plugin with the following spec: podSelector matching label app=graphql-resolver, policyTypes=['Egress'], egress rules allow only TCP port 443 to CIDR 10.0.0.0/8 (internal VPC DynamoDB VPC endpoint) and deny-all for link-local range 169.254.0.0/16. Additionally, the EKS node group has IMDSv2 enforced (HttpTokens=required, hop-limit=1) which prevents container-level metadata access even if network policy were bypassed. The Envoy sidecar operates in STRICT_DNS mode with cluster definitions only for the DynamoDB VPC endpoint.

config.service_mesh: AWS App Mesh with Envoy STRICT_DNS, only DynamoDB VPC endpoint in cluster config
